response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates deep systems expertise across distributed, high-throughput environments and strong ownership via operational roles, with direct exposure to AI-agent tooling at re:cinq — aligning well with the agentic engineering mindset. His full-stack fluency, open-source leadership, and cross-functional collaboration experience meet core requirements, though limited explicit Python mastery and minimal evidence of agile scrum champion rotation are minor gaps.
strengths: Proven experience in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq
Deep distributed systems background with high-throughput, low-latency systems (e.g., DLang, millions of req/s)
Strong ownership demonstrated via open-source leadership, DevOps setup, and operational roles
concerns: Python expertise not explicitly highlighted despite being a must-have
No clear evidence of rotating scrum champion or formal agile ceremony leadership
